retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast vintage layout featuring ultra-bold purple typography over a dark teal field with a central rounded-corner photographic inset.
triggerTerms: dark teal background with inset photo
excludeWhen: modern minimalist white space is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark teal square composition dominated by massive, purple, ultra-bold sans-serif text at the top, with a vertical rectangular photo of a porcelain doll in grass centered below it.
coreVisualRelationships: Massive title text spanning the full width of the upper third
Smaller subtitle centered above the main title
Rounded-corner photographic inset centered in the lower two-thirds
High contrast between purple elements and dark teal background
coreInvariants: Ultra-heavy sans-serif letterforms with minimal tracking
Dark teal or deep forest green background field

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photographic subject is a medium-scale inset centered vertically and horizontally in the lower portion of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive purple title text acts as the primary visual anchor due to its scale and color contrast.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top subtitle, drop to the massive title, and then settle on the central photographic inset.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark teal background provides significant negative space around the central photo inset.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural Greens and Flesh Tones (Inset Photo)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the purple text against a low-value, muted background.

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning where letters almost touch
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'V' and 'E' in the main title are scaled to maximum width to fill the horizontal space.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between massive uppercase purple display and small lowercase white subtitle.
graphicDevices: Rounded-corner rectangular frame for the inset image

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and vertical presence.
Offers the tight, blocky feel of the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark teal square background. In the center of the lower two-thirds, place a vertical rectangular photo with rounded corners showing a porcelain doll lying in tall green grass with a soft, slightly hazy vintage film texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a massive ultra-bold sans-serif title in vibrant purple across the top third. Above that, center a small subtitle in white lowercase bold sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the main title purple and ultra-bold?
Is the background a dark teal color?
Does the central photo have rounded corners?
Is the subtitle in lowercase white text?

adjustableVariables: Corner radius of the inset photo
mustRedesign: Do not use sharp-cornered rectangles for the inset image
Ensure the title text is not transparent

mustAchieve: Vintage film grain on the inset photo
avoid: Centered text that is too small

postGenerationChecks: Check that the purple text is the largest element.
Verify the teal background is uniform and dark.
Ensure the doll photo is hazy and vintage in style.
Confirm the subtitle is centered and lowercase.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Dark Teal Background] + [Rounded Inset Photo] + [Ultra-Bold Purple Display Type] + [Small White Subtitle].
